title: KVTierSim: KV-Cache Tiering for Long-Context LLM Decoding
description: Trace-driven simulator and results for HBM + CXL/LPDDR5X KV-cache tiering in long-context LLM decoding, with and without query-aware sparse attention, including the Criticality-Guided Placement (CGP) policy. Contains the simulator (Python), experiments E1-E6, CSV results and figures.
